note: Army rules that let units into an army without the army's faction keyword. build_data.py (apply_army_groups) gives them their own faction keyword + group, never locks them to a detachment, and lets their Characters be the Warlord only with the detachments named. Edit by hand from the Warhammer 40,000 app.

adeptus-custodes._src: Warhammer 40,000 app v995 (2026-10-16) via https://www.40k.app/factions/anathema-psykana/army-rules, checked 17 Oct 2026: army rule ANATHEMA PSYKANA - 'You can include ANATHEMA PSYKANA units in your army, even though they do not have the ADEPTUS CUSTODES faction keyword. When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated: You cannot select ANATHEMA PSYKANA as your army faction. You cannot select an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model to be your WARLORD.' Null Maiden Vigil (Silent Sisterhood): 'When mustering your army, you can select a friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA CHARACTER model to be your WARLORD.'
